topic: Should There Be Limits on Freedom of Speech to Prevent Hate Speech?

Part of feeling safe is that you are not subject to hateful speech, which can threaten your existence by leading to violence, cause emotional strife and prolonged stress, and leads to the general public feeling a sense of disunity. Because of these net negatives, free speech should be limited to prevent people from saying things that are untrue or things that are calls to violence against a specific group of people. Some people may be concerned with who gets to delineate the bounds of what is "good" speech, but these can be well defined in an un-biased manner.
